inlines.v: ANIMADVERT', verb intransitive [Latin animadverto, of animus, mind, and adverto, to turn to.] 1. To turn the mind to; to consider. 2. To consider or remark upon by way of criticism or censure. 3. To inflict punishment; followed by upon.
